fairness_rules: No cross-theory numerical performance claim without identical equations and conventions.
Source-published values are not Symtropy-reproduced values.
A low collocation residual is not a full-domain enclosure.
A full-domain residual enclosure is not by itself an existence theorem.
A local existence theorem does not establish EFT validity or observational admissibility.
Inconclusive is not refuted and not verified.
Akribeia's 5D/7D Lovelock cases are not directly comparable to 4D pure-Weyl cases; compare only after action/dimension/ansatz/gauge/boundary matching.
Akribeia's reported ~1e-160 relative L2 error is a Myers-Perry GR-limit result at 300-digit precision, not a universal error on all higher-curvature branches.
Akribeia's continuous neural-field certification and quantified residuals are not to be equated automatically with an interval/radii-polynomial existence theorem.
